title: The Healthy child in the village
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：healthy　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 healthy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the observer wrote of ① a healthy child in the village in the log, and everybody in the observatory said at once that it was ② healthier than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the observer, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the healthy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the healthiest child in the village anybody in the observatory had ever seen, or so the log for November 1951 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too healthy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the healthy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a healthy diet of the old man, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as healthy as the diet of the old man they had once had in the old observatory. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was healthy or not, and he said so.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something healthy, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next observatory called the whole plan ⑧ quite healthy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the healthy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967, in silence, she wrote of another healthy child in the village in the same log, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ healthier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The healthiest diet of the old man in the whole observatory, she said in 1969, was the one she could never quite name; the healthy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 健康（前置定语 a healthy child in the village：1957 年观测员在观测记录里记下的那件健康的孩子）
B. adj. 健康／有益健康（比较级 healthier than：文中两处，一处比村里健康的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 健康／有益健康（最高级 the healthiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 健康（表语 too healthy to do：母亲觉得它太健康，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有益健康（前置定语 a healthy diet of the old man：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有益健康的饮食）
F. adj. 有益健康（同级比较 as healthy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老人健康的饮食相比）
G. adj. 有益健康（后置定语 something healthy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有益健康（受程度副词修饰 quite healthy：那位助手的评价）

items.q: a healthy child in the village
the healthiest child in the village anybody
a healthy diet of the old man
The healthiest diet of the old man in

answers.why: healthy 意为“健康”，1957 年观测员在观测记录里记下的是“一件健康的孩子”，此处作前置定语 a healthy child in the village。
healthy 意为“健康”，此处用比较级 healthier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
healthy 意为“健康”，观测记录上 十一月 那行字说它是观测站里最健康的一件，故用最高级 the healthiest child in the village。
healthy 意为“健康”，母亲认为这件东西“太健康了，谁也用不上”，too healthy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
healthy 意为“有益健康”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有益健康的饮食”，此处作前置定语 a healthy diet of the old man。
healthy 意为“有益健康”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老人健康的饮食一样有益健康”，同级比较用 as healthy as。
healthy 意为“有益健康”，观测记录上那半行字要的是“有益健康的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something healthy。
healthy 意为“有益健康”，邻观测站来的那位助手认为这套计划“相当有益健康”，quite 修饰原级 healthy。
healthy 意为“有益健康”，1967 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要有益健康”，故用比较级 healthier than。
healthy 意为“有益健康”，母亲 1969 年说的是“整个观测站里最有益健康的那一桩”，故用最高级 the healthiest diet of the old man。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，观测员在观测记录里记下了一件健康的孩子。（a healthy child in the village）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更健康。（healthier than …）
母亲觉得它太健康，谁也用不上。（too healthy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩有益健康的饮食。（a healthy diet of the old man）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老人健康的饮食一样有益健康。（as healthy as …）
到了 1964 年，观测记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件有益健康的东西。（something healthy）
answers: In 1957 the observer wrote of a healthy child in the village in the log.
Everybody said it was healthier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too healthy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a healthy diet of the old man.
He said nobody would call it as healthy as the diet of the old man they had once had.
By 1964 the log asked for nothing but something healthy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 healthy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the observer wrote of a healthy child in the village in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the healthiest child in the village in the observatory, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too healthy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a healthy diet of the old man, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next observatory called the plan quite healthy, and everybody laughed.
The healthy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
